description_en: Queries city information by using a city name as the keyword. This operation applies to both domestic and international city code queries
description_zh: 调用本接口，以城市名作为关键字查询对应的城市信息，适用于国内/国际城市 code 的查询
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen base-city-info-search --keyword '杭州' --biz-region 0 --x-acs-btrip-access-token fet0000wls --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BaseCityInfoSearch

parameters.help_en: The search keyword, which is the city name
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise access credential.

This is a required header parameter for HTTP calls. To obtain the credential, refer to Enterprise access credential (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985).
You can use corp_token=value in the request URL as a replacement
parameters.help_zh:
企业访问凭证。

是 HTTP 调用方式的 header 必填参数之一，获取方式请参见：企业访问凭证 (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985)。
可以在请求地址中使用 corp_token=value 替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_access_token
